name: mcp-computeflux
description: Zero-dep MCP server exposing ComputeFlux (or any OpenAI-compatible) models to MCP agents.
long_description: Gives any MCP host (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) two tools over stdio: computeflux_models to list available models and computeflux_chat to chat with any of them. stdlib-only, no node_modules, single server.mjs. Point it at ComputeFlux or any OpenAI-compatible gateway.

tools.name: computeflux_models
tools.description: List the model IDs available on the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint

tools.name: computeflux_chat
tools.description: Chat with any configured model (system + user turns, max_tokens, temperature)

computeflux_api_key.title: ComputeFlux API Key
computeflux_api_key.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Required.

computeflux_base_url.title: Base URL (OpenAI-compatible)
computeflux_base_url.description: v1 base URL. Leave blank to default to https://api.computeflux.ai/v1
